constraints: no access to inventory, other submissions, or compiler internals by instruction
no compiler feedback before submissions freeze
no replacement of implementations to improve compatibility results

validation.shape_profiles: existing predefined three per task; four for smoothing
validation.mock_fixtures: seven existing fixtures plus 12 seeded independent random fixtures per profile
validation.real_proofs: one nonzero fixture at profile 0 for each program that passes correctness

interpretation: LLM-based independent submissions within the GPT-5.6 family, not human participants or statistically independent model families.
